title: Minor comfort and control wishes
summary: This topic combines one clear complaint about a rattling headrest with several undetermined wish-list comments about range, cabin controls, ride height, and sunshade clearance.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes a front headrest that rattles over bumps or potholes.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments express wishes for more range, more manual controls, a slightly higher ride height, and better sunshade clearance around the rearview mirror.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined wishes rather than clearly evaluative reviews.
This cluster mixes unrelated subjects including headrest noise, driving range, manual controls, ride height, and sunshade interference.
The sample is small, so examples are insufficient to support broader conclusions about the topic.
